assets.name: 공용 거점
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster PNG board-space icon for Lumen Party. ONE icon only on a square transparent canvas. A perfectly flat 2D regular octagon viewed exactly perpendicular, horizontal top and bottom, vertical sides, equal diagonal cuts. Match the reference icon's centered octagonal silhouette, thick dark navy #26334D border, thin ivory inset octagonal keyline, scale and padding. Cute fantasy board-game UI, bold ivory pictogram with dark navy outlines and rounded joins, smooth crisp edges readable at 64 pixels. This is a flat printed tile face, never a physical pedestal. Solid opaque colored fill inside octagon; all exterior genuinely transparent alpha. No perspective, extrusion, cast shadow, bevel, lighting, glow, scenery, texture, words, numbers, watermark or extra icons. Keep flat uniform colors rather than the reference's subtle surface gradients. Output square 1024x1024 or higher. Reference 1 is a STYLE reference and the existing player home icon. Generate the matching SHARED HOME. Replace the amber fill with neutral warm stone gray #B8B5AE. Retain the simple ivory house with pitched roof and chimney, plus the tiny ivory diamond crystal above the roof. Replace player numeral with a tiny clear community pictogram inside the house: three dark-navy round heads above a single short curved shoulder bar, simple shared-users symbol. No player numeral and no ownership color. Keep the large house centered and instantly readable. Only the home, tiny crystal and small users symbol; no arrows.
